# ScreenToVideo

> ScreenToVideo is a screen recorder and video editor for Windows (11, 10, 8 and 7, 64-bit) with AI background blur, AI virtual backgrounds, AI silence removal and AI voice-overs (Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, using the customer's own Google Cloud account, or built-in Microsoft voices). It is a one-time purchase ($119 regular, $79 educational) with free lifetime upgrades and a free, fully featured 15-day trial.

ScreenToVideo is made by Tatomir N. Alex PFA and has been developed since 2019. It records the screen (full screen, a window or a region), webcam, microphone and system sound, and includes a full video editor for adding text, shapes, zoom and pan, effects, transitions, animations, captions and interactivity. Videos export to MP4, WMV, animated GIF, animated WebP, audio-only formats, an interactive HTML player, or directly to Google Drive. It is rated 4.7 out of 5 on AppSumo.

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows only (64-bit Windows 11, 10, 8 or 7). No Mac version.
- Price: one-time license, no subscription. Regular $119, Educational $79. Multi-license discounts from 20% (2-5) to 36–37% (21+). 30-day money-back guarantee.
- Free trial: 15 days, all features; exported videos are watermarked until a license is registered.
- Licensing: per user; the registered user can install it on all of their own computers.
- System requirements: Intel Core i-series or AMD Phenom II, 2 GB RAM, 500 MB disk space, 1280x720 screen.
- Current version: 2026.1.

## Recording features
- Screen Recording: Capture an application window, a chosen area, or your entire screen.
- Webcam Recording: Record your webcam with AI background blur or a virtual background — no green screen needed.
- Microphone: Record your microphone while presenting, or add a voice-over while editing.
- System Sound: Capture all sounds played on your computer, e.g. applications and games.
- Drawing Tools: Draw, highlight, and write on screen while recording.
- Screenshots: Take screenshots in the middle of the action.
- Adjustment: Application & Video mode for smooth, high-quality videos.
- Quick Results: Record directly to mp4/gif with no export time.

## Editing features
- Import Media: Import and edit your image, video, and audio files directly in the project.
- Annotations: Annotate your presentation with dynamic text enclosed in smooth shapes.
- Sketch: Focus attention on specific areas with animated sketches.
- Effects: Highlight or hide information using the built-in effects (blur, pixelate, etc.).
- Shapes: Use geometric shapes to mask objects.
- Cursor Effects: Highlight your actions with custom cursor effects.
- Zoom and Pan: Change the perspective of the viewer to an interesting area.
- Zoom Area: Bring valuable content closer to your viewers’ eyes.
- AI Background Blur: Blur the background of any video or image with AI to keep the focus on you.
- AI Virtual Background: Replace the background of any video or image with AI — no green screen needed.
- Chroma-Key: Remove a solid-color background with professional results.
- Media Speed: Speed up or slow down your video or audio.
- Drawing Tools: Draw, highlight, and write on images while editing.
- AI Silence Removal: Automatically find and cut silent pauses in your audio or video.
- AI Text-to-Speech: Turn your script into a natural-sounding voice-over with Google’s neural AI voices (uses your Google Cloud account).
- Narrate: Enhance the presentation with your voice while editing the video.
- Loudness Normalization: Normalized audio from multiple sources fits perfectly into your video.
- Keystrokes: Annotate tutorials with your keystrokes without lifting a finger.
- Text Animations: Animate your text with a variety of transitions and textures.
- 3D Transformations: Show your content from a different angle with rotations on all three axes.
- Transitions: Move from one scene to another with continuous predefined transitions.
- Text Variables: Show the elapsed time and other variables in texts.
- Multiple Selection: Select, copy, and paste multiple objects with their properties.
- Arrange: Set the perfect position on both the timeline and the canvas.
- Timeline Selection: Easily select, play, and remove timeline intervals.
- Animations: Move and transform all objects with smooth custom animations.
- Closed Captions: Create, import, and export closed captions for all your project videos.
- Progress Bar: Illustrate the elapsed time by adding a minimalist progress bar to your videos.
- Interactivity: Create buttons and video events to provide more interaction with your viewers.

## Publishing features
- Export for Any Device: Choose the perfect export format to be displayed on any device – PC, phone, or tablet.
- HTML Player: Embed your video in an HTML player that enables interactivity in any browser.
- Animated GIF: Create short animated GIFs for your entire video or just a section of it.
- Share Online: Get a shareable link to your videos uploaded directly to Google Drive.

## Frequently asked questions
### Does ScreenToVideo have AI features?
Yes. AI background blur and AI virtual backgrounds work while you record your webcam and in the editor, on any video or image — no green screen needed. AI Text-to-Speech turns your script into a natural-sounding voice-over with Google’s neural voices (using your Google Cloud account) or the built-in Microsoft voices, and AI silence removal cuts pauses from your recordings automatically. Every AI tool is included in the free trial.

### Is there a free trial?
Yes. You can download a fully featured 15-day free trial. All of ScreenToVideo’s features are available, but your exported videos are watermarked. The projects you make with the trial are fully usable once you register.

### Is it a subscription?
No. ScreenToVideo is a one-time purchase with no monthly or yearly fee. The license is perpetual and never expires, and it includes free lifetime upgrades and support.

### Can I install it on more than one computer?
Yes. ScreenToVideo is licensed per user, not per machine, so the registered user can install it on as many computers as they own. Only the registered user may use the software.

### Which formats can I export to?
MP4, WMV, animated GIF and animated WebP, plus audio-only MP3, WAV and M4A. You can also embed your video in an interactive HTML player or upload it directly to Google Drive and get a shareable link.

### What do I need to run it?
A 64-bit version of Microsoft Windows 11, 10, 8 or 7, an Intel Core i-series or AMD Phenom II processor, 2 GB of RAM and 500 MB of disk space.

### Are there discounts for schools or teams?
Yes. Students and teachers can get the Educational license for $79. Buying several licenses saves you 20% (2–5 licenses), 30% (6–10), 34% (11–20) or 36–37% (21+).

### How do I receive my license key?
Orders are handled securely by PayPro Global. As soon as your order is processed, you receive an email with your registration key, which activates the full version.

### What if it’s not right for me?
Every purchase comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

### Does ScreenToVideo work on Mac?
No. ScreenToVideo is a Windows app and needs a 64-bit version of Windows 11, 10, 8 or 7.

### Can I record my screen and webcam at the same time?
Yes. You can record your screen together with your webcam, microphone and system sound, and add AI background blur or a virtual background to the webcam without a green screen.

### Do exported videos have a watermark?
Only during the free trial. Once you register a license, your videos are exported without a watermark, and projects you made in the trial keep working.
